description: HTX (formerly Huobi) 24h ticker for one market (e.g. btcusdt): open, high, low, close, bid/ask, base and quote volume and trade count, from HTX's public market tickers endpoint. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_bitget_tickers when you need Bitget spot ticker for one pair: last price, bid/ask, 24h; finance_bitstamp_tickers when you need Bitstamp spot ticker for one pair: last, bid, ask, 24h. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
